clauses.title: Limitation on Indebtedness of Restricted Subsidiaries
clauses.operativeSummary: Company will not cause or permit any Restricted Subsidiary to incur/create/assume/permit Indebtedness except four baskets: (i) acquisition/existing-at-join Indebtedness not incurred in contemplation; (ii) Indebtedness owing to Company, Restricted Subsidiary, or Worthington Receivables; (iii) non-facility LCs capped at $30,000,000 aggregate face; (iv) other Restricted Subsidiary Indebtedness ≤ 10% of Consolidated Net Tangible Assets.
clauses.entityScope: Restricted Subsidiaries (not a Company-level general debt negative covenant)

basket_iii.metric: aggregate face amount of LCs not issued under the Agreement

basket_iv.basis: aggregate principal amount at any time outstanding

residuals: No general Company Indebtedness negative covenant in §6.01
clauses.expectedExecution: REFUSE production capacity without CNTA evidence (iv) and without LC utilization evidence (iii). Hypothetical capacity may illustrate formulas only if labeled non-authoritative.
citationAnchors: The Company will not cause or permit any Restricted Subsidiary to, directly or indirectly, incur, create, assume or permit to exist any Indebtedness except:
shall not exceed $30,000,000 in the aggregate at any time
not in excess of 10% of Consolidated Net Tangible Assets

clauses.title: Restriction on Liens
clauses.operativeSummary: Company will not, and will not cause or permit any Restricted Subsidiary to, incur/create/assume/suffer any mortgage/pledge/lien/charge/encumbrance on any assets other than Permitted Liens.
conditions: Exception set is entirely by reference to definition Permitted Liens
residuals: No standalone % CNTA general lien basket in Permitted Liens; clause (xvii) only secures Indebtedness permitted under §6.01(iii); clause (x) has $50,000,000 incidental non-debt lien subcap
clauses.expectedExecution: Representation must resolve Permitted Liens definition. Production capacity for 'general lien basket' should REFUSE if seeking a % grower that is not in the text.

clauses.title: Financial Covenants
clauses.operativeSummary: (a) Interest Coverage Ratio for any four consecutive fiscal quarters ≥ 3.25:1.00, tested quarterly. (b) Consolidated Indebtedness / Capitalization ≤ 55%, tested quarterly.
conditions: four-quarter period for Interest Coverage Ratio
residuals: Leverage Ratio is defined in Art I but is NOT the §6.13 tested covenant; tested leverage-style metric is Indebtedness to Capitalization

clauses.title: Interest Coverage Ratio
clauses.operativeSummary: Consolidated EBITDA / Consolidated Interest Expense for the period.
citationAnchors: Interest Coverage Ratio ” means, for any period, the ratio of (i) Consolidated EBITDA of the Company and its Subsidiaries for such period to (ii) Consolidated Interest Expense of the Company and its Subsidiaries for such period.

clauses.title: Consolidated EBITDA
clauses.operativeSummary: Consolidated Net Income + interest/tax/D&A/non-cash expense items − interest income/non-cash income/gains, GAAP. Material acquisition/divestiture: for Interest Coverage Ratio, adjust pre-deal period by adding acquired historical results (no cost savings/synergies unless Required Lenders approve) or deleting divested results.
conditions: Acquisition/divestiture adjustment limited to Interest Coverage Ratio measurement context
clauses.formula: CNI + Interest + Taxes + D&A/impairment/non-cash expense − interest income − non-cash income/gains (+/− acquisition/divestiture hist. adjust for ICR)
